scientific_question: On the archived 50-edge Al-Al direct-contact graph, do intact native oxide films suppress conduction, or can a small metallic bridge fraction dominate current and Joule localization?

input_contract.canonical_lf_algorithm: replace CRLF and bare CR bytes with LF before SHA-256

network_boundary_contract.bottom_electrodes: reuse archived surface-intersection particle IDs at 0 V
network_boundary_contract.top_electrodes: reuse archived surface-intersection particle IDs at fixed voltage
network_boundary_contract.solve: full resistor network with Dirichlet electrodes and KCL at internal nodes
network_boundary_contract.fixed_current: scale the same linear network solution to total current 1 A
network_boundary_contract.shortest_path: report separately; never substitute for full-network equivalent resistance

stop_conditions: Do not rerun DEM or COMSOL for this gate.
Do not fit metallic bridge fraction to an expected temperature.
If KCL or power balance fails, stop before interpretation.
If source applicability is insufficient, retain review and specify the minimum experiment instead of widening claims.
